web_context.competitor_activity: All three largest Medicare Advantage competitors — UnitedHealthcare, Humana, and Aetna/CVS — have scaled back MA plan coverage for 2026 (fewer states and counties) to recover margins, signaling sector-wide MA pressure but a disciplined retreat. A Massachusetts federal court cleared an antitrust suit against Zelis, Aetna, Cigna, Humana, and UNH relating to out-of-network payment suppression. Humana has pivoted entirely to senior/MA care; CVS remains the closest vertically integrated rival. The MA margin recovery cycle appears industry-wide, but UNH's scale and integrated Optum platform give it an edge.
